title: Datacenter Incident Response
description: Datacenter incidents affecting utility infrastructure and operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on utility operations and customer services
investigation_steps: Review network and server equipment status
resolution_steps: Activate backup cooling systems if needed
Coordinate with facilities team for environmental issues
verification: Confirm with operational staff that systems are operational
special_considerations: Datacenter outages can affect utility operations regionally
Operational technology incidents require NOC escalation
Coordinate with facilities team for physical infrastructure issues
